segments.sn27.3:1.3: Yo sotaviññāṇasmiṃ … yo ghānaviññāṇasmiṃ … yo jivhāviññāṇasmiṃ … yo kāyaviññāṇasmiṃ … yo manoviññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso.
segments.sn27.3:1.8: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnañcassa cittaṃ hoti.
segments.sn27.3:1.9: Nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.
